subject.title: fix(gateway): bound BOOT.md file read size

question: Should a `BOOT.md` larger than 16 MiB be silently skipped as empty, or return a visible failed boot result?
rationale: Both outcomes prevent unbounded allocation, but only the failed result tells operators that configured startup instructions did not run; tests cannot choose that product behavior.

options.title: Fail visibly on overflow
options.body: Return a failed boot result containing the size-limit reason while allowing gateway startup to continue.

options.title: Skip oversized files
options.body: Keep the proposed skipped/empty result and intentionally accept reduced operator visibility.

recommendation.title: Fail visibly on overflow
recommendation.body: Return a failed boot result containing the size-limit reason while allowing gateway startup to continue.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced gateway `BOOT.md` execution and its original result contract.
